title: US markets closed — Labor Day (the only session inside the 2026-09-05 FOMC blackout's first three days)
source: NEWS: nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars, fetched 2026-09-06 by the ppi-2026-09-10 pulse-check adjacency sweep. The page's 2026 holiday table gives Labor Day as 'Monday, September 7' and states that 'All NYSE markets observe U.S. holidays as listed below'; the same read returned no early closure anywhere in September 2026. Independently reproduced by weekday arithmetic: 5 U.S.C. 6103 fixes Labor Day on the FIRST Monday in September, and the first Monday of September 2026 is 2026-09-07 (2026-09-01 is a Tuesday, consistent with this calendar's own dated entries — ISM manufacturing on 09-01, ADP and the Beige Book on 09-02, the August employment report on Friday 09-04). Filed estimate rather than confirmed on the same three counts the sibling closure entries record (good-friday-market-closure-2027-03-26, presidents-day-market-closure-2027-02-15, memorial-day-market-closure-2027-05-31): the confirmed-prefix taxonomy in market-events-data.ts has no slot for an exchange operator's own hours page, this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep, and the SIFMA fixed-income side was not fetched here. The DATE is not in doubt — the estimate label is about the taxonomy, not the evidence
notes: DISCOVERED during the ppi-2026-09-10 pulse-check adjacency sweep (2026-09-06), and it is a plain GAP rather than a judgment call: this calendar already carries a full family of US market-closure entries — presidents-day-market-closure-2027-02-15, good-friday-market-closure-2027-03-26, memorial-day-market-closure-2027-05-31, juneteenth-market-closure-2027-06-18, plus the christmas-eve-half-day-2026-12-24 and thanksgiving-half-day-2026-11-27 early closes — and carried nothing for Labor Day in any year. Checked mechanically this session: no entry in src/domain/market-events/ had date 2026-09-07 before this one. WHY THE DATE EARNS A ROW HERE: it sits three days before ppi-2026-09-10 and four before cpi-2026-09-11, inside a corridor this calendar tracks densely (treasury-3y-note-2026-09-08; aapl-iphone-18-launch-2026-09-09, treasury-10y-note-2026-09-09, treasury-buyback-increase-2026-09-09, eia-steo-2026-09-09; ecb-decision-2026-09-10, treasury-30y-bond-2026-09-10, treasury-buyback-10y20y-2026-09-10, treasury-coupon-announcement-2026-09-10; cpi-2026-09-11, umich-sentiment-prelim-2026-09-11, mts-august-2026-09-11; treasury-20y-bond-2026-09-15; fomc-2026-09-16). The consequence is structural and recorded rather than traded: the run-in to the 09-16 decision is a FOUR-session week (09-08, 09-09, 09-10, 09-11), so every pre-FOMC print lands in a compressed window and no US tape reaction may be read off 09-07. It also falls inside the fomc-blackout-start-2026-09-05 window, which the memorial-day-market-closure-2027-05-31 entry measured as ordinary: Labor Day falls inside 5 of the 166 FOMC blackout windows derivable 2007-2027, so a holiday inside a blackout is routine and carries no signal of its own. IMPACT LOW AND SYMBOLS EMPTY: a closed session moves nothing by itself, no house playbook is calendar-keyed, and this entry widens caution and licenses nothing. HONEST LIMIT ON THE KIND FIELD: EventKind (src/domain/market-events-types.ts) has no market-structure member, so this is filed 'sector' — the same least-wrong choice the four sibling closure entries documented, and no new kind is invented here.
